race.comment: KING COBAMA (6) has been a bit diamonds or stones of late. Produced a gutsy performance last start to lead all the way and defy the challengers over this distance at Gatton. Big chance again if Cejay Graham can dictate. OUT OF LUCK (8) stepped back sharply in trip and was on a six-day back-up when an eye-catching second last time out over 1300m at Toowoomba. Tricky gate to contend with but if things go right he is capable of taking this out. SPEED MAP (1) was 39 days between runs when he led and just failed to hold on in an open sprint over this trip at Casino recently. Fitter for that outing and looks a key runner despite shouldering 62kgs. Lightly raced four-year-old FIERCE LUVA (16) made late ground to grab second over the mile at Warren last start. Back in trip but given a one-month freshen. Has more upside than most of these. LAMBERTINA (11) won here at this trip in a BM58 earlier in the prep. Continues to race well deep into the campaign and must be considered.
